title: EFT Pathways to $|ΔB| =2$: Chiral Constructions and Phenomenology
summary: We develop a systematic effective field theory framework for studying $|ΔB|=2$ interactions across energy scales. Using chiral symmetry, we construct the complete and non-redundant set of operators governing these interactions at low energies and establish their connection to the corresponding operators in the Standard Model effective field theory, as well as to their realizations in baryon chiral perturbation theory.
